entries.label: eating at home
entries.reason: A meal at the person's own home. Slightly less preferred than eating out so that streets with cafes see people come and go.

entries.label: eating out
entries.reason: A meal at premises whose use class declares eating, between 07:00 and 22:00. Only premises the place publishes can host it.

entries.label: resting
entries.reason: Sitting or standing still at a declared rest place. A place that reviews its own rest duration (Flatiron declares 3 minutes) overrides this range.

entries.label: shopping
entries.reason: An errand at premises whose use class declares shopping, between 08:00 and 20:00.

entries.label: sleeping
entries.reason: Sleep at the person's own home, starting between 21:00 and 03:00 and lasting six to nine hours.

entries.label: at home
entries.reason: Spending free time at home. Weighted below walking so that free time is split between the street and home.

entries.label: walking
entries.reason: Walking to another open standing spot on the navigation graph and pausing there. It needs only the graph, never an invented destination, and it is the fallback when nothing is urgent.

entries.label: visiting
entries.reason: Stopping at a declared visit place. A place that reviews its own visit duration (Flatiron declares 1 minute) overrides this range.

entries.label: working
entries.reason: A shift at the premises that supply the person's role. The shift window comes from the use-class entry, and its weight puts it ahead of every need while the shift is due.
